senses.definition: (physiology) The chemical processes that occur within a living organism in order to maintain life.
examples: The metabolisms of aerobic bacteria require oxygen

senses.definition: (physiology, by extension) The rate at which these processes occur for a given organism
examples: Small animals have a much higher metabolism than large animals because they lose more body heat

senses.definition: (figurative, by extension) The processes that maintain any dynamic system.
